records.narr_swing_public: Whether the FY27 reset works — INTU has now diagnosed the core crack as PRICE, not AI ("Price is now the reason customers leave TurboTax"), and is deliberately trading DIY ARPC and a 5pp-lower long-term GBS algorithm (15-20% -> 10-15%) for volume and e-file share. The thesis hinges on whether that buys a reacceleration in new-to-the-franchise customers (online paying customers +3%, two points slower than last year) inside FY27-FY28, or whether it is the first leg of a durable de-rating of the growth algorithm that the Big Bets (30% of revenue, +34%) cannot outrun.
